text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool rp-ded-03 queued_requests > 1200 for 3m, 503 spike on /v1/generate (window=5m) :rotating_light:

rachel: oncall here, ack. paging list? I'll grab the throttle toggles and check autoscale.

tomas: I'm looking at metrics — GPU utilization ~85% and request queue length climbing. autoscaler hasn't added new nodes due to cooldown.

sunita: support: seeing ~15 customers with 5xx; two reported production errors (acme-inc, berry-app). severity user-impacting.

rachel: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable burst capacity for rp-ded-03 (10m) 2) enable per-customer rate limits for free-tier 3) disable non-critical heavy features (reranking) for public routes 4) watch metrics and rollback if error rate rises.

liam: +1 to disabling reranking. That feature causes extra tokens and KV ops. Can we gate it at API layer?

tomas: I can flip burst. command I'm going to run:```bash
rictl pools toggle-burst --pool rp-ded-03 --enable --duration 10m --reason "oncall surge response"
```

ops-bot: rictl job started: toggle-burst rp-ded-03 (job id j-9842). ETA ~30s.

rachel: also temporarily set quota_multiplier=0.5 for anonymous/free keys on /v1/generate to reduce noise. Tomas can you apply?

tomas: applying rate-limit override:```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "policy": "tier:free",
  "qps": 1
}
```
ops-bot: rate-limits updated for policy tier:free on /v1/generate.

karen: support -> reached out to ACME engineering lead; they confirmed retries were causing cascade. Suggested they backoff for a bit.

ben: monitoring: queue length dropped from 1300 -> 220 within 90s of burst enable. 99th percentile latency down from 1.8s -> 0.9s. 503 rate down to baseline.

rachel: nice. Keep burst on for the 10m window, then auto-evaluate. We'll extend if traffic sustained.

liam: should we also move a couple of noisy customers to a separate dedicated pool (rp-burst-temp)? Might be safer for tail latency.

tomas: I can create a routing override for ACME + berry-app to rp-burst-temp and drain lp capacity. Will do after we confirm stability.

ops-bot: rictl job completed: toggle-burst rp-ded-03 (j-9842) -> success.

sunita: updated status on customer incident page: "mitigated, rerouting and burst enabled; engineering monitoring".

rachel: handoff: I'm wrapping up now, will update runbook with threshold tweak (queued_requests alert -> 800 to page). Tomas will be secondary oncall for the next 30m.

tomas: ack. I'll keep an eye and follow up with a post-incident checklist: 1) evaluate autoscaler cooldown settings 2) add burst-scaling playbook 3) add per-pool soft quotas for noisy tenants.

liam: also add a quick toggle in console to disable reranking for hosted customers (product task).

rachel: closing notes: incident resolved by burst toggle + temporary rate-limits. No broad data loss. Will file postmortem and link here. Thanks all :heart: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT: auto-close scheduled in 2h unless new alerts.
